title: 2027 Point72 Academy Spring Insight Programme – UK
content: <p>The Spring Insight Programme is a short, paid introduction to investing at Point72 for first-year university students in the UK. Over two weeks you will meet investment professionals, learn how a multi-strategy fund is run and work through practical exercises with a small group of peers.</p><h3>What you'll do</h3><ul><li>Join workshops on fundamental equity research, macro investing and the technology behind the firm</li><li>Work in a team on a stock pitch and present it to portfolio managers</li><li>Hear from people across investing, risk and operations about their careers</li></ul><h3>What we're looking for</h3><ul><li><p>First-year undergraduates of any degree discipline at a UK university</p></li><li><p>A genuine curiosity about markets, businesses and how prices move</p></li><li><p>Clear communication and the ability to work well in a group</p></li></ul><p>Successful participants may be invited to interview for the summer internship the following year.</p>
